+import subprocess
+import requests
+from flask import request
+
+CALLBACK = "http://partner-bank.example.com/settlements"
+
+@app.route("/webhooks/settlement", methods=["POST"])
+@token_required
+def settlement():
+    batch = request.json["batch_id"]
+    subprocess.run(f"python scripts/reconcile.py {batch}", shell=True)
+    requests.post(CALLBACK, json=request.json, timeout=5)
+    return "", 204
